description: article_geometry v2: stronger topic key. _PT now returns the alphabetically-sorted SET of all [[Category:X]] tokens in the page (vs v1's single first category). Falls back to first {{template}} or <title> when no categories. Normalization truncates at 240 chars (vs 120) for finer-grained sort. Selector picks min of raw vs reordered with 1B mode tag + 16B integrity hash for the ordered mode. Wraps lc4rmrl_z core
